remote-tool-scan.title: Tools on this node
remote-tool-scan.source_changed: This record is historical. The current node identity or detection capability has changed; start and configuration actions are unavailable.
remote-tool-scan.boundary: Detection records installation observations only. It does not install tools, verify model access, register a configuration or enable task dispatch. Historical results do not prove the node is currently available.
remote-tool-scan.invalid_response: The node returned an invalid detection record. Read the original request again.
remote-tool-scan.status.ready: Detection is available on this node. Start it explicitly.
remote-tool-scan.status.capability_unava: This node has not declared a current detection capability. Use the guide to connect it with detection explicitly allowed.
remote-tool-scan.status.write_unknown: The request acknowledgement is unknown. Check the original request before starting another detection.
remote-tool-scan.status.pending: Waiting for this node to receive the request.
remote-tool-scan.status.claimed: This node is checking the requested tools.
remote-tool-scan.status.completed: Detection completed. Review a tool before preparing its configuration.
remote-tool-scan.status.failed: The node confirmed that detection did not start.
remote-tool-scan.status.unknown: The execution result is unknown. Read the original request; do not start a replacement scan.
remote-tool-scan.status.closed_unknown: The native processes have stopped, but the original detection result remains unknown.
remote-tool-scan.status.expired: The request expired before it was claimed.
remote-tool-scan.status.superseded: The target identity changed before the request was claimed.
remote-tool-scan.status.forbidden: Current access could not be confirmed. Observations have been cleared; the original request is preserved for reconciliation.
remote-tool-scan.status.invalid: The result could not be confirmed. Read the original request again.
remote-tool-scan.status.timed_out: Stopped waiting after one minute. The original detection is not canceled; read it again to check its result.
